title: Fly Fishermen by Stone Bridge, 1930s River Landscape Vintage Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription: See the men fishing under the bridge they wade all up & down fly fishing 10
description: A tranquil rural landscape photograph capturing a riverbank framed by the bare, curving branches of a large tree during late autumn or early spring. In the background spans a historic stone masonry arch bridge, beneath which tiny silhouettes of fly fishermen can be seen wading through the water. The back bears a handwritten message in fountain pen ink observing the anglers.
